name: Cursor Pro

reset.rule: Resets on your monthly billing date.
stipulations: Cursor's usage API reports the exact cycle end.
Auto counts here only when it routes to a Cursor model. When Auto or a subagent uses a third-party model, that usage comes from the third-party pool.

meters.label: Third-party models pool
meters.hint: Claude, GPT, Gemini at API price

reset.rule: Resets on your monthly billing date.
stipulations: Each request is charged at that model's API list price.
Cursor sometimes adds bonus usage on top of the included amount.

overage: On-demand usage bills monthly in arrears at API rates, up to the spend limit set at cursor.com/dashboard/spending. It's off by default; quota-board shows whether yours is on.

how: Two monthly pools that reset with your billing cycle: Cursor's own models, and third-party models at API price.
ext: Third-party models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) are available and drain the third-party pool at each model's API list price, with no markup.
quirks: Pro is no longer sold. If you switch, Cursor offers Premium ($30) or higher on the new weekly-pool plans. You lose on-demand billing and can't come back; Support can't reverse a switch.
Cursor doesn't publish Pro's pool sizes. The usage API reports percentages.
